s.zh: 不能落到未探索的地方。
巨灵正处于许愿后的倦怠中，血脉能力暂时无法使用。
s.en: The genie is weary after granting a wish; bloodline abilities are unavailable for now.
Lightning can't pierce through the mountain.

s.zh: 泰坦（天穹神裔）在地图上时，每天黎明看一次心情：心情≥80%天气转晴，≤30%转雷雨。关闭后泰坦不再影响天气。
s.en: When a titan (sky-born) is on the map, its mood is checked at every dawn: mood ≥80% turns the weather clear, ≤30% turns it to thunderstorms. When off, titans no longer affect the weather.
